title: Add and subtract with number-line hops

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Adding and taking away become hops on a number line. The numbers are one step apart, and they get bigger to the right.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A hop's length is how many steps it covers. Forward hops go to the right and add. Back hops go to the left and take away.

do.text: Length: the steps a hop covers
Back: to the left, take away

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start at sixty-three. Hop forward twenty, then forward five. Where do you land?

do.text: Start at $63$. Hop forward $20$, then forward $5$. Where do you land?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Hop the tens first: twenty is two tens. Sixty-three hops to eighty-three. Only the tens digit changes, and the three ones stay the same.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Then the five ones take us from eighty-three to eighty-eight, the landing number.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twenty and five make twenty-five, so sixty-three plus twenty-five is eighty-eight in all.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The number line shows two jumps that start at fifty-six. Which story matches the jumps?

do.text: The number line shows two jumps that start at $56$. Which story matches the jumps?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: She earns twenty-eight, then earns eight more.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The first jump goes to the left, toward the smaller numbers, so it takes away. She spends twenty-eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The second jump goes to the right, so it adds. She earns eight more.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Maya has fifty-six dollars. She spends twenty-eight, then earns eight more. Same start, same amounts, same order.

do.text: Maya has $56$ dollars. She spends $28$, then earns $8$ more.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A hop goes from ninety-five to seventy-nine. How long is the hop?

do.text: A hop goes from $95$ to $79$. How long is the hop?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Its length is the steps it covers, whichever way it goes. So count up from seventy-nine, first to the next ten.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Seventy-nine to eighty is one. Eighty to ninety is ten. Ninety to ninety-five is five.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: One plus ten plus five is sixteen, so the hop is sixteen long.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Check: seventy-nine plus sixteen is ninety-five.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: To find a landing, follow the hops. To find a length, count the steps between the ends.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Right adds, left takes away. Hop the tens, then the ones.

do.text: Hop the tens, then the ones.
